facts.text: Above the upper lake, the easy slabs to its north-east are a pleasanter option than the wet gully on the far side, from July through September.
In July and August, rocks kicked loose in the cliff band near 6,100 ft tumble onto the boulder field below; keep parties well apart.
In August and September there is flowing water above the lakes, including near a tarn around 6,700 ft, so extra carrying above the lakes is unnecessary.

notes: Report 2928984 (Aug) climbs a north-west ridge from North Blum Lake via a snow finger, which neither route describes.
